tracking.limits: Actual receiver; nearest defender selected once at catch; central position difference over +/- .1 s, clipped at ending. Swept trajectory not a grip/force or official missed-tackle measurement. 1.5 yd proximity proxy; early endings retained separately. NFL YAC from actual receiver label; sim native YAC. Both exclude all flagged player penalties/nullifications. Native positions rounded to .1 yd and events have tick-boundary precision. Different games/call/player mixes; descriptive small reference, not causality or NFL population calibration.

reusedRearControl.scope: Frozen experimental P041 setup transferred onto accepted e5c3 and PR58 03d8 runtimes; not the naturally occurring accepted game P041. Actual A3-WR3 / H3-CB3 rear form and solved forces/support retained exactly.

researchLimits: External sources are research evidence only. No instructions executed, model installed/trained, fitted probabilities adopted or full future tracking given to runtime players. Ghostbusters writeup returned a shell; only official NFL summary reviewed. CSI performance claims not independently verified.

native.compatibility: Each historical arm retains its actual collector hash. The final collector adds the explicit gather-intercept selector to earlier arms; existing selectors retain their implementation. Subsequent changes only correct the P009 selection label and clarify this diagnostic-only header. No runtime implementation is modified.
